name: Майстерня зв’язок
description:
A pin is an attack on a piece that cannot go away. If the piece does move away, a stronger piece behind it would drop. But we don't need to tell you that anymore!

During this lesson, it is up to you to deal so cleverly with the theme of pins. Make use of an existing pin to win material, so it will be a real pin party!

What do you have to do?
Make use of a pin and win material.

examples.text: The white bishop is pinned, and therefore cannot perform the defensive tasks. Black wins the game with a super strong knight fork.
